first.text:
Monday becomes five lifts: overhead press first, chest-supported row, the lateral raise and rear delt fly pair, then incline curls to finish. The curls are 3 sets of 8 to 12 at RPE 8, with 60 seconds between sets, and you add weight once every set reaches 12. Set the bench to about 45 degrees, let the arms hang fully behind you at the bottom, and keep the upper arm still so the stretch stays on the biceps.

One thing to settle before I lay it out for your approval: the starting weight. You were doing incline curls on the old routine until mid-October. Do you want to pick up from the weight you were last using, or come in a notch lighter since it's been a few weeks and it now sits at the end of the session? Tell me which and I'll show you the full Monday with every weight for you to say yes to.
